title: My Kind of Glow
caption:
My Kind of Glow

I have always been drawn to skin with a glow.

A finish should follow the look —
dewy, soft-focus, or matte.
Yet for my own face,
I return to glow, almost every time.

Glow reads as health, as light,
as skin that has been looked after.
Even with a matte lip or a matte eye,
I leave the skin luminous.
It is, I admit, a little flattering, too.

Humidity changes the story.
In Singapore, or in a Japanese summer,
glow turns to shine within hours.
Here, the art is in the balance.

Knowing more than one way to create it
lets you choose a glow
that belongs to your city, and your life.
